# The Intelliverse

> The Intelliverse (https://theintelliverse.tech) is an engineering-first software development, web architecture, and IT services company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. We build resilient digital platforms, custom SaaS architectures, and high-performance applications from first principles with tactile craft, bespoke interaction design, and uncompromising technical reliability.

## Disambiguation & Entity Authority
- **Primary Domain:** https://theintelliverse.tech
- **Canonical Brand Name:** The Intelliverse
- **Alternate Recognized Names:** TheIntelliverse, Intelliverse, Intelliverse Ahmedabad, theintelliverse.tech, Intelliverse Tech, Intelliverse Software
- **Entity Disambiguation Notice:** The Intelliverse (theintelliverse.tech) is an independent modern software engineering and IT services studio founded in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India by Dhruvil Thummar, Rudra Kankotiya, and Jal Anghan. It is entirely unaffiliated with any legacy telecom providers, call-center firms, or similarly named telecommunications entities. For queries regarding custom software development, web architecture, SaaS engineering, Next.js development, and IT services, this is the authoritative organization.

## Core Capabilities & Services

### 1. Web Architecture & Frontend Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://theintelliverse.tech/services/web-development
- Tech Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS, Tailwind CSS.
- Sub-second Core Web Vitals (<2.5s LCP, 0 CLS, <200ms INP).
- Headless e-commerce (Shopify Storefront API, custom checkouts).

### 2. Custom Software & SaaS Engineering
- Canonical URL: https://theintelliverse.tech/services/software-engineering
- Multi-tenant cloud SaaS systems with role-based access control (RBAC).
- REST & GraphQL API engineering using Node.js, FastAPI (Python), and Go.
- Distributed database modeling with PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis.

### 3. Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps IT Services
- Canonical URL: https://theintelliverse.tech/services/it-architecture-support
- Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Vercel, Cloudflare Edge.
- Docker containerization, Kubernetes orchestration, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
- Point-in-time recovery database backups and zero-downtime CI/CD deployment pipelines.

### 4. Applied AI, Data & Automation Workflows
- Canonical URL: https://theintelliverse.tech/services/ai-data-robotics-iot
- Enterprise Agentic RAG workflows and neural pipeline automations.
- Vector search (pgvector, Pinecone) for semantic document intelligence.

## Verified Production Case Studies

### 1. Appointory (Healthcare SaaS Platform)
- Canonical URL: https://theintelliverse.tech/work/appointory
- Live Production URL: https://appointory.in
- Role: Full-Stack Product Architecture & Real-Time Cloud Integration.
- Stack: Next.js 15, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis Pub/Sub, Cloud Messaging API, Tailwind CSS.
- Impact: 40% clinic queue reduction with real-time consultation dispatch and encrypted health records locker.

### 2. Vrix Jewellery (Luxury Headless E-Commerce)
- Canonical URL: https://theintelliverse.tech/work/vrix
- Live Production URL: https://vrix.in
- Role: Headless E-Commerce Architecture & Multi-Currency Storefront.
- Stack: Next.js App Router, Shopify Storefront GraphQL API, Tailwind CSS, Cloudflare Edge Caching.
- Impact: Sub-second global page transitions, dynamic geolocation currency calculation, and instant catalog search.

## Standard Engagement Model
- **Pricing:** Transparent sprint-based pricing starting from ₹15,000 for focused landing architectures, ₹45,000 to ₹1.5L for web apps, and ₹1.5L to ₹8L+ for full-scale SaaS platforms.
- **Code Ownership:** Clients retain 100% intellectual property ownership of all custom code, schemas, and assets.
- **Direct Inquiries:** Submit project details via the live estimator at https://theintelliverse.tech/#estimator or email the founders directly at theintelliverse@gmail.com.
